result.summary: Pushed feature/WF02-batch-3-20260811 (33 commits) to origin, opened PR #713 with an honest split-release description (PAR-01/PAR-04 RELEASED, PAR-02/PAR-03 TESTED pending ISS-0670/GH-711, plus the PAR-01 AC4 rework cycle). First CI run (31524488824) surfaced a genuine, non-flaky BLOCKER: python tools/check_github_status.py confirmed GitHub Actions was operational, so the red 'Tenant isolation tests (TNT-01..04)' check (29/34, 5 failures: TC-TNT-01-02/01-04/02-01/07-02/07-04, 'business table events found in public') was attributable to this branch's own change, not infra flake -- the most recent main-branch CI run (fd069f14, run 31501446173) had passed this exact check. Root-caused to migrations/1147_par01_events_partitioning.sql (this run's own PAR-01 migration): its Migration 1 DROP/CREATE for events/events_archive ran unconditionally on every schema pass including public, recreating tables GBL-112 had already permanently dropped from public as PER_TENANT business tables. Per core-directives.md Unblock-Everything ('a broken migration that blocks yours' is explicitly in-scope, not filed-and-forwarded), fixed in place: wrapped Migrations 1-3's DDL in a current_schema()-guarded DO block using EXECUTE'd dynamic SQL (migration files run via conn.simpleQuery(), not psql, so top-level DDL cannot itself be conditional -- confirmed by reading src/db/migrations.zig), plus an explicit same guard on Migration 4 for defense-in-depth. Verified locally against db_test (port 5433) before repushing: test-integration-tnt 34/34 (was 29/34), all 6 batch-specific PAR targets unchanged (2/2, 5/5, 4/4, 3/3, 4/4, 29/29), full unit suite 1067/1131 clean (0 failures, matches RELEASE-VALIDATOR's Step 5 baseline exactly), a genuinely fresh-database zig build migrate exits 0 with events/events_archive confirmed absent from public afterward, and both lint_migration_schema.py and lint_test_table_refs.py clean. Pushed fix commit fa447f83; second CI run (31525729039) went 8/8 green including Tenant isolation tests. Squash-merged via gh pr merge --squash --delete-branch; local git errored on gh's own post-merge 'git checkout main' step only (main is checked out in the sibling worktree C:/Users/tvolo/dev/ai-dala/R-Co, this worktree cannot check it out directly -- same constraint as prior batches in this run) -- verified via gh pr view --json state,mergeCommit that the merge itself landed (state MERGED, mergeCommit 38cb7967) independent of that local error. gh's --delete-branch had not yet run when the local error interrupted it, so the remote branch was deleted explicitly via gh api -X DELETE; confirmed gone via a 404 branch lookup and git fetch --prune showing '[deleted] ... origin/feature/WF02-batch-3-20260811'. Local cleanup: git checkout --detach origin/main (working-tree-content equivalent, per this run's established precedent, since main cannot be checked out directly in this worktree), then git branch -D feature/WF02-batch-3-20260811 -- confirmed the local branch no longer appears in git branch -a and the working tree is clean.
